entries.title: I Timothy 2:1
segments: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings should be offered for every one,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:2
segments: especially for kings and all who are in high positions, in order that we may lead a quiet and peaceful life in a deeply religious and reverent spirit.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:3
segments: This will be good and acceptable in the eyes of God, our Savior,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:4
segments: whose will is that every one should be saved, and attain to a full knowledge of the Truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:5
segments: There is but one God, and one mediator between God and men--the man, Christ Jesus,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:6
segments: who gave himself as a ransom on behalf of all men. This must be our testimony, as opportunities present themselves;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:7
segments: and it was for this that I was myself appointed a Herald and an Apostle (I am telling the simple truth and no lie)--a Teacher of the Gentiles in the Faith and Truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:8
segments: My desire, then, is that it should be the custom everywhere for the men to lead the prayers, with hands reverently uplifted, avoiding heated controversy.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:9
segments: I also desire that women should adorn themselves with appropriate dress, worn quietly and modestly, and not with wreaths or gold ornaments for the hair, or pearls, or costly clothing,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:10
segments: but--as is proper for women who profess to be religious--with good actions.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:11
segments: A woman should listen silently to her teachers, and show them all deference.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:12
segments: I do not consent to a woman's becoming a teacher, or exercising authority over a man; she ought to be silent.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:13
segments: Adam was formed first, not Eve.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:14
segments: And it was not Adam who was deceived; it was the woman who was entirely deceived and fell into sin.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:15
segments: But women will find their salvation in motherhood, if they never abandon faith, love, or holiness, and behave with modesty.
